title: ProjectHub
description: Enterprise-grade Agile management platform featuring a real-time reactive Kanban board, two-tier Role-Based Access Control, and an in-process event bus.

title: 2D Billiards
description: A highly optimized, custom-built 2D physics billiards engine written entirely from scratch. Features strict Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and 100% domain test coverage.

title: Code Reviewer
description: Autonomous CI/CD code review agent that uses Google Gemini and Octokit to detect architecture, security, and performance issues in pull requests and publish native inline comments.

title: Job Matcher
description: Autonomous cloud-native recruitment agent that uses Google Gemini to evaluate job offers against a candidate profile and delivers curated matches to Discord.

title: Azure Infra Hub
description: A centralized cloud management architecture provisioned via Terraform on Microsoft Azure. Features isolated VNETs, Zero Trust security with Managed Identities, and automated CI/CD deployments.

title: GymCore
description: A comprehensive, highly-concurrent SaaS platform built for boutique fitness clubs. Features Clean Architecture, CQRS, Stripe API integrations, and optimistic concurrency control.

title: Portfolio Site
description: A decoupled, framework-less interactive portfolio powered by Vanilla JS, JSON, and fully containerized with Docker.

title: GameNest
description: Digital Game Distribution Platform built from scratch using a custom MVC architecture and Object-Oriented Programming.

title: Finance Tracker
description: Desktop personal finance management app utilizing data-binding concepts and local storage.

title: Hotel API
description: RESTful API for a hotel reservation management system.
